answer: Fixed schedules fail: forgers rest on inspection day. A VRF draws 5% each epoch; each drawn identity must submit work proof within 2 epochs. Seven jurors verify it; absence freezes rewards 6 epochs, a second miss slashes 50%. A falcon circling unseen can land anywhere; no hoarder knows which clone to wake. A trellis of 1,000 clones locks 120,000 units; each round costs 6,000 in absence penalties. The walnut is hard: ten rounds cost 60,000 units.
